tool.name: PIMENTO Choose primer cutoff
tool.description: Selects optimal primer cutoff and generates final inferred primer sequences
tool.command: ## Empty cutoffs input (no candidate inflection points): touch an empty ## output instead of running, as the pipeline's CHOOSE_PRIMER_CUTOFF ## does with its `if [[ -s ]]` guard. if [ -s '$primer_cutoffs' ]; then pimento choose_primer_cutoff -i '$input_reads' -p '$primer_cutoffs' -o sample; else touch sample_auto_primers.fasta; fi
tool.help: Choose the optimal primer cutoff point from an input set. Using patterns of base-conservation in reads and a set of potential cutoff points to choose from, this function makes a prediction for the "optimal" cutoff point to be used for primer inference. This function then generates a consensus sequence using the reads and the chosen cutoff point to be used as the final primer sequence. Performed for both strands, the final primer sequences are output into a FASTA file.
